notes: Feeds W8-18l (dialogs::native::painter::geometry and mod). Reflection over the internal static class NativeDialogChromePainter, DialogColors, CommonControlsInit of the PhotoReview (Shell.Win32) assembly.

kind_for creates a REAL child window of the class (a hidden popup STATIC owner, WS_CHILD | style, 50x20) and calls KindFor(hwnd, class): outputs kind_name (enum name), value (int), style_read (the style the window reports back, uint). The window is destroyed afterwards.

predicates -> is_full_paint, has_flat_border, tracks_hover (private statics taking the int value of the kind); repaints -> value (RepaintsAfterSystemPaint(int kind, uint message)); scaled -> value (private S(double scale, int value); inputs scale and px); key_color -> found and value (DialogColors.FromKey, uint COLORREF) or threw.

custom_draw allocates a zeroed 136 byte NMLVCUSTOMDRAW, writes dwDrawStage at +24 and uItemState (item_state_in) at +64, hwndFrom = 0 (so LVM_GETITEMSTATE answers 0: the row is never selected here; the selected branch is a hand-written pure test) and calls AdjustListViewCustomDraw(ptr, result_in): outputs result (the returned nint as long), item_state (uint at +64 after the call), text_color (uint at +80), back_color (uint at +84).
constants -> control_subclass_id, dialog_subclass_id (private const nuint), control_prop, dialog_prop (private const string), kinds (object name -> int of ChromePaintKind).
